module names.initials
  purpose: Extract initials from full names.

public function initials(full_name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased initials of a full name, separated by nothing.
  example: initials(full_name: "ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials(full_name: "  john   doe  ") is "JD"
  example: initials(full_name: "x") is "X"

  let words be full_name.trim().split(" ")
  let filtered be
    for each word in words
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  end
  let result be
    for each word in filtered
    collect word.characters.first.to_upper()
  end
  return result.join("")
end
```
